identity.title: EHT-HOPS Pipeline for Millimeter VLBI Data Reduction

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present the design and implementation of an automated data calibration and reduction pipeline for very long baseline interferometric (VLBI) observations taken at millimeter wavelengths.

question.value: How can an automated HOPS-based pipeline calibrate mm-wavelength VLBI data (GMVA+ALMA, EHT), and how does it compare with a classical AIPS reduction?

evidence.quote: demonstrate the benefits from the specialized processing of high-frequency VLBI data with respect to classical analysis techniques.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 86 GHz; 512 MHz total (256 MHz per polarization); four channels of 116 subchannels per polarization

evidence.quote: A total bandwidth of 512 MHz (256 MHz per polarization) was recorded at each station except YS
At correlation, the bandwidth per polarization was divided into four channels of 116 subchannels each.

evidence.quote: the Robert C. Byrd Green Bank Telescope (GBT), the Yebes 40m telescope (YS), the IRAM 30m telescope (PV), the Effelsberg 100 m telescope (EB), and the ALMA phased array of 37 antennas
observations of Sgr A$^{\ast}$ on 2017 April 3 (project code MB007)

analysis_steps.goal: Fringe fit with iterative phase calibration

method.value: Five fourfit stages: bandpass, ad hoc atmospheric phase, RCP-LCP delay, global fringe solution

evidence.quote: The first five stages of the pipeline run several iterations of `fourfit` (cite: fourfitmanual), while solving for nonlinear phase corrections and a global fringe solution.
sets a threshold $\rho_\text{thr} \sim 7$ above which detections are considered reliable

fitting.value: Least-squares station-based delays/rates with soft_l1 loss at scale 8 sigma (Scipy)

evidence.quote: The least-squares minimization is performed in Scipy with an additional `soft_l1` loss function

analysis_steps.goal: A priori amplitude, polarization calibration and network calibration

method.value: Convert to UVFITS; apply SEFD from ANTAB tables, field rotation, RCP/LCP gain ratios, network calibration

evidence.quote: The post-processing stages 7–9 that follow read and write `UVFITS` formatted data directly and apply amplitude calibration and polarization- and time-dependent phase corrections

analysis_steps.goal: Compare with AIPS reduction and image NRAO 530

method.value: Compare detections, correlation amplitudes, closure quantities, and closure-only images between HOPS and AIPS

evidence.quote: We have performed a comparative analysis of the GMVA+ALMA data set processed by the EHT-HOPS pipeline and a classic AIPS reduction.

validation.value: Normalized closure differences smaller than a standard normal; images consistent

evidence.quote: indicates that differences between the pipelines are of subthermal magnitude, even after full scan averaging.

evidence.quote: HOPS (cite: Whitney_2004)
